description: A React component implementing a password change wizard with form validation, modal UI, and password update logic.

classes.name: PasswordWizard
classes.description: A React component class for a password change wizard modal.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Focuses the current password input when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes window unload handler when component unmounts.

methods.name: registerWindowUnloadStopper
methods.description: Sets a handler to prevent window unload during password change.

methods.name: resetContinueState
methods.description: Resets spinner and continue button state.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Handles progression to the next step, including validation and password change.

methods.name: validateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Validates current password and confirmation, and checks user email.

methods.name: processPasswordChange
methods.description: Performs password change, backup download, and updates UI state.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Closes the modal unless tasks are pending.

methods.name: handleCurrentPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Updates current password in form data.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Updates new password in form data.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordConfirmationInputChange
methods.description: Updates password confirmation in form data.
